<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Reset: clear path using ACTION7
seg = current_frame.segmentation
paths = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'w' and n['pixels'] == 4]
print(f"Current path: {len(paths)}")

# Clear path
while len(paths) > 0:
    result = action(['ACTION7'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    paths = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'w' and n['pixels'] == 4]

# Move to row 24 (near Red block)
result = action(['UP'])
seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'M' and n['pixels'] == 18:
        b = n['boundary']
        r_min = min(p[0] for p in b)
        print(f"Char row: {r_min}")
        break

# Extend path from row 24
result = action(['RIGHT'])
seg = current_frame.segmentation
paths = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'w' and n['pixels'] == 4]
print(f"Path after 1 RIGHT: {len(paths)}")

# Extend more
for i in range(4):
    result = action(['RIGHT'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    paths = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'w' and n['pixels'] == 4]
    blocks = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] in ['R', 'b', 'N'] and n['pixels'] == 16]
    block_order = sorted([(min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']), n['color']) for n in blocks])
    main_blocks = [(r,c) for r,c in block_order if r < 50]
    print(f"RIGHT: path={len(paths)}, blocks={main_blocks}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
